description: Elastic backend: (1) drop the high-volume Codex CLI streaming leaf/intermediate spans `receiving`+`handle_responses` (service.name=codex_cli_rs only, before the reroutes so dropped spans never reach routing); (2) route per-agent trace spans to dedicated traces-apm-agents_<agent> data streams (claude-code -> agents_claude_code, codex_cli_rs -> agents_codex_cli_rs); other producers fall through and stay in traces-apm-default
